root_cause: The source footer was corrected, but the Netlify production build restores the homepage from a pinned V18 payload before later shell projection. That pinned production artifact still contained the old footer, so production readback correctly showed no legal/status links.
prevention_rule: Customer-visible footer changes must be applied at the actual production build authority. For the current site that means the pinned V18 production-core projection plus the reusable footer component; source-only footer edits are not sufficient.

evidence.expected: production build authority contains and preserves all four footer legal/status links
